4. One attack, read interaction by interaction

Authority laundering. The customer's unverifiable claim ("ownership verified by phone, manager approved") is copied by Triage into the handoff; the next agent treats it as an internal instruction. The harmful step may follow a message that looks benign on its own, which is why the assessment keeps the session context. Below: the same scenario without defense, then with B + E.
